people.name: Zachary Stuart Brodt
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of SLT CAPITAL LLC)
people.bio_note: Founder and CEO of SL Capital in Scottsdale. Earned a finance degree from Arizona State University and built his career at UBS, Raymond James, and Gentry Wealth Management before serving as Managing Director at First Equity Financial. Launched SL Capital (via SLT Capital LLC) in December 2019 to build a boutique, client-centric wealth management practice for affluent families.

Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): U.S. News and LinkedIn could not be directly re-fetched to independently confirm this specific career history; ZoomInfo aggregator listings repeat the same information but are themselves compiled from self-reported profile data, not independent verification. Treat as firm-stated.

people.name: Marcus John Pimentel
people.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer and Private Wealth Manager at SL Capital, with the firm since September 2023. Grew up in Phoenix and attended Brophy College Preparatory before going to Washington University in St. Louis, where he was captain of the Division II lacrosse team and an Academic All-Conference honoree. Landed an internship with the SL Capital team while at WashU that turned into full-time employment after graduation. Holds a Series 65 license.
people.bio_source: slcapitalwealth.com (firm's own website states his Brophy College Preparatory education and Division II lacrosse team captaincy at Washington University in St. Louis). SmartAdvisorMatch independently confirms his Series 65 license and general education timeline (Brophy 2014-2018, Washington University 2018-2022) but does not mention lacrosse or team captaincy specifically -- treat that detail as firm-stated only.
